extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI): the user-controlled 'username' query parameter is concatenated directly into the Jinja2 template source via Jinja2.from_string("Welcome " + username + "!").render(). An attacker can supply Jinja2 template expressions (e.g., {{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() }}) in the 'username' parameter, which are evaluated server-side, leading to arbitrary Python code execution / remote code execution. The safe alternative (passing username as a render variable) is commented out on line 17.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: Reflected XSS: the 'username' query parameter is rendered into the response and returned as HTMLResponse without any output encoding. The Jinja2 Environment() is created without autoescape (line 11), so any HTML/JavaScript in 'username' that survives rendering is returned with content-type text/html, allowing script execution in the victim's browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
